test_is_in_series: test the polars Series.is_in method to check if series elements are contained in a list of values
test_is_in_df: test the polars DataFrame column is_in method to filter rows where column values exist in a given list
test_is_in_struct: test the polars struct type is_in method to check if struct elements match entries in a struct list
test_is_in_null_propagation: test polars is_in null propagation behavior with nulls_equal parameter for left, right, and both sides
test_is_in_large_uint64: test polars is_in precision handling for large integers beyond Float64 range using UInt64 and Int64 types
